_source: Telangana Development Planning Society (TGDPS) automatic weather stations
_licence: Telangana government publication, cited with attribution
_note: 185-odd AWS inside GHMC_CMC_MMC, each with coordinates and daily cumulative rainfall. This is a MEASURED intra-city rainfall surface - every other city on the platform interpolates from a single IMD 0.25-degree grid cell. values.jsp exposes only the LATEST reading per station with no date parameter, so this file is the station registry plus a snapshot; running it daily is what builds a series. Historical bulk lives on data.telangana.gov.in.
